remarks: Be the first to live in this spectacular, fully-remodeled home. Spanning 2,184 sqft, this residence features 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and an open-concept living area with a brand-new kitchen. The master bedroom has stunning water front views with a private balcony and a walk-in closet. Step out onto your private deck off the kitchen and enjoy direct waterfront access and stunning views of Mill Pond and Norwalk Harbor. The lower level includes an in-law suite with its own kitchen and a walk-out basement. New washer and dryer are included in a private laundry room. The property also offers a private entry for added convenience. Commuting is a breeze with the East Norwalk train station just a 0.4-mile walk away, and you can enjoy the vibrant local scene with nearby parks, marina, and restaurants all within walking distance. This home is a must-see for anyone seeking luxury and an exceptional location. $4,900/month.
